title: Scotty’s Castle reopens for limited tours 11 years after Death Valley flash flood forced its closure
summary_full: More than a decade after a flash flood forced Scotty’s Castle to close, Death Valley National Park is bringing visitors back for limited exterior tours from October 10 as a $71 million restoration effort continues.
